issues: Kafka and ClickHouse (transitive via the snuba devservices dependency) are dropped with no explicit note — the 'Leaf datastores' comment gestures at the indirection but never names them or points users at `devservices up`, so a reader can't tell they were detected and deliberately deferred
No mention of the rest of the devservices graph (snuba, relay, symbolicator, taskbroker) or the kafka-consumer ingest programs
pnpm is provisioned via corepack at activation instead of pinning the catalog's pnpm_10, adding a network dependency for a version the repo already pins (packageManager = pnpm@10.30.2)
Hook starts and stops a full postgres instance just to bootstrap databases; the golden does the createdb inside the service command, keeping activation cheap
PGDATA is exported in [hook] and consumed by [services.postgres] — works via activation env inheritance but couples the service to hook ordering rather than being self-contained
gcc installed solely to locate libstdc++.so.6 is a heavyweight way to get a runtime lib onto LD_LIBRARY_PATH
No note about pyproject pinning uv's default index to Sentry's private mirror (pypi.devinfra.sentry.io), which will fail `uv sync` outside Sentry's network

schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Runtimes — versions pinned by the repo's own pin files
python313.pkg-path = "python313"          # .python-version 3.13.1 / setup.cfg python_requires >=3.13
nodejs_24.pkg-path = "nodejs_24"          # .node-version 24.14.0
uv.pkg-path = "uv"                        # Brewfile; uv.lock is the Python source of truth

# Leaf datastores — sentry talks to these directly (devservices/config.yml)
postgresql_14.pkg-path = "postgresql_14"  # scripts/upgrade-postgres.sh NEW_VERSION=14
redis.pkg-path = "redis"

# Every wheel in uv.lock is prebuilt, so nothing compiles — but the manylinux
# wheels still dlopen system libs at import: psycopg2-binary wants libz,
# python-rapidjson wants libstdc++. Both are self-hosted/Dockerfile buildDeps.
zlib.pkg-path = "zlib"                    # buildDeps: zlib1g-dev
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"                      # buildDeps: gcc — supplies libstdc++.so.6

# Tooling
watchman.pkg-path = "watchman"            # Brewfile + devenv/post_fetch.py REQUIRED_APT_PKGS

[vars]
# Matches sentry's DATABASES default in src/sentry/conf/server.py
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "sentry"
REDIS_PORT = "6379"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  cd "$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT"

  # --- PostgreSQL: port of scripts/lib.sh create-db -------------------
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    # scripts/lib.sh creates all four: sentry plus the siloed-mode databases
    for db in sentry control region secondary; do
      createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -E utf-8 "$db" >&2 || true
    done
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi

  mkdir -p "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/redis"

  # --- manylinux wheels need libstdc++ on the loader path (python-rapidjson,
  # imported by sentry.utils.json, fails at import without it). Ask gcc where
  # its own runtime lives rather than hardcoding a path.
  _libstdcxx="$(gcc -print-file-name=libstdc++.so.6 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ -e "$_libstdcxx" ]; then
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$(dirname "$_libstdcxx")${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
  fi

  # --- Python: uv.lock is fully wheels, no compilation needed ---------
  # Keep uv on the Flox interpreter — left alone it downloads its own CPython
  # into ~/.local/share/uv and the Flox pin stops meaning anything.
  export UV_PYTHON="$FLOX_ENV/bin/python3"
  export UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
  # The dir must be named .venv: tools/fast_editable.py asserts "/.venv/" is in
  # the site-packages path. It stays under the cache, never in the repo tree.
  export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/.venv"
  uv sync --frozen --no-install-project >&2
  # pyproject.toml has no build-system o
